# Garden scenery

Generated using the built-in image generation tool. Dawn and snow are edits of the sunlight reference, with the same garden layout. Outputs are encoded as 1536 × 1024 JPEGs at quality 86 for web delivery. The window remains a separate 3D model.

## Sunlight prompt

Create a photorealistic landscape photograph for a realistic 3D wooden window simulator. A quiet Chinese residential garden seen from a house at eye level: irregular old grey stone pathway leading away from foreground, natural layered shrubs and grasses, a graceful mature maple with fine branching and individual green leaves, bamboo at the edges, weathered grey courtyard wall and distant tiled roof partially hidden by foliage. Authentic photographic textures, subtle atmospheric depth, detailed natural leaves, real-world scale, restrained natural colors, soft bright daylight from upper left, 50mm architectural photography. Wide horizontal image 3:2. Full bleed exterior view only, NO window frame, NO interior, NO people, NO text. Garden extends to all edges with no conspicuous central object; designed to be seen behind window panes. Not illustration, not stylized 3D, not low-poly. Save as project asset; return local image path if available.

## Snow edit prompt

Edit this exact photographic garden into winter after fresh snow. Preserve exact camera, framing, pathway, rocks, courtyard wall, roof and tree positions so this is recognizably the same garden. Snow naturally coats the stone path edges, rocks, roofs, branches and evergreen bamboo leaves. Maple mostly bare fine branches. Cold blue-grey overcast daylight, soft realistic ambient light and atmospheric distance. High photographic realism, no illustration, no window frame, no text, no people. Few subtle snowflakes in distant background only; real-time foreground flakes will be added separately. Same horizontal 3:2 framing.

## Dawn edit prompt

Relight this exact photographic Chinese garden at warm dawn. Preserve exact camera, framing, pathway, rocks, courtyard wall, roof, every tree and plant placement, and green foliage. Low golden sunrise from right side illuminates leaf edges and stone path, soft long shadows, a little subtle morning mist in distance, warm cream highlights and neutral cool shadows. Real architectural photography with natural fine textures, restrained cinematic realism, NOT orange filter, no stylized render. No people, no text, no window frame. Same horizontal 3:2 composition, full bleed exterior only.
